_note: Assumed inputs, frames and frozen design values for 7.5. Paths are {key: path_for key, rel: relative}. Build agent, 2026-11-05. Edit freely. The partner, permissions and the primary estimand are user decisions.

reserved_area.schema: polygon(s) of the reserved area held out from all tuning, EPSG:6346

candidates_frozen.state: from 5.4 S1 (distinct candidate sites at K = 40 per km2). Hash kept in the sample key
candidates_frozen.schema: site_id, max_score, cx, cy, block_id. The older cand_id, score, cx, cy schema still draws but cannot feed the 5.4 export

morphology._note: column on the annotation layer if present (well_age_morphology.md). Else one class per layer

era_rules._note: Era proxy from the nearest DEP record within the radius. The 1800 sentinel is its own stratum and is never early era. A dated historic mark makes early_map

density_export._note: 7.5 to 5.4 handoff (review F16). A found well is detected when a frame site lies within detector_link_m (the protocol search radius). Round-2 wells within well_merge_m of a round-1 well in the same cell are the same well. Both radii need user confirmation, see decisions_7_5.md

design.primary: arm A weighted share of drawn features that are confirmed wells
design._target_note: bound width at or under the target means success (precision). There is no failure condition for a measurement
